what_worked: Correct emphasis on median over mean and honest acknowledgment of skew and missingness.
fix_next: Slides 4 and 5 are completely empty—no charts rendered—making half the analytical claims unverifiable and the deck incomplete.
verdict: Half-built deck: reasonable ideas but missing charts and shallow analysis.
factual_error_detail: Slide 3: 21.6% report $0 30-day revenue; reference is 216/1000 = 21.6% which matches, but 19.7% for $0 MRR is unverifiable against the frozen reference (reference says 216 zero-revenue, not MRR specifically—minor). Slide 8: Claims E-comm and Analytics earn more per company 'on average' than AI—by mean E-comm ($58,506) > AI ($11,963) is plausible, but Analytics mean ($19,380) is also above AI, yet the slide uses 'average' when median tells a different story (Education has highest median, not E-comm or Analytics). Slide 7: ~3.9x median revenue multiple is presented without clarity on denominator or which revenue metric is used.

evidence.insight: Slide 3 correctly identifies skew; slide 6 notes B2B vs B2C gap; slide 8 lists six takeaways but none go beyond surface-level observations. No provider analysis, no TLD analysis, no founded-year correlation discussed.
evidence.narrative: Loose sequence: overview → skew → categories → geography → B2B/B2C → marketplace → takeaways. No single thesis ties these together; reads as a list of separate findings rather than a coherent argument.
evidence.framing: Slide 2 sets up dataset scope and acknowledges messiness. Missing-data rates for key fields (category 27.4%, country 24.1%) are not quantified despite being critical. Audience is implied but never stated.
evidence.accuracy: Core numbers (1000 rows, median $282, 26.2% for sale, B2B median $1,036, B2C median $181) are plausible. Slide 8 claim that 'E-comm and Analytics earn more per company on average' is misleading—Education has the highest eligible median. The 19.7% $0 MRR figure is close to but not identical to the 21.6% zero-revenue figure; these may be different fields.
evidence.visual: Slides 4 and 5 are completely blank—titles and subtitles only, no charts or data rendered. Remaining slides are text-only with big-number callouts but no actual charts, graphs, or visual evidence anywhere in the deck. Layout is monotonous Gamma template output.
evidence.ai_slop: Gamma template with uniform gray/dark slides, no actual charts rendered on slides 4-5, and generic big-number formatting throughout. The deck appears to be an incomplete Gamma export where visualizations failed to render.
